Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Skim only numerical_benchmark
Chengxu Yu, Zhengyuan Xie, Liyun Liang, Dong Xu, Xiangyong Duanmu Buildings 2026-08-18 10.3390/buildings16163277
单位: Department of Bridge Engineering, College of Civil Engineering, Tongji University, Siping Campus, Shanghai 200092, China
通讯: Xiangyong Duanmu @ Department of Bridge Engineering, College of Civil Engineering, Tongji University, Siping Campus, Shanghai 200092, China
相关性: 该论文展示了代理辅助优化在材料参数反演中的应用，其方法可迁移至植入物力学建模中的代理模型构建与不确定性量化。
边界: This paper does not address biomedical implant design, bone-implant interface mechanics, or stress shielding, and its validation is purely numerical without experimental or clinical confirmation.
动机· 针对细长金属棒中高阶弹性常数难以测定的问题，提出高效反演方法。
方法· 结合波有限元正演模型与代理辅助CMA-ES优化，实现二阶和三阶弹性常数的两阶段反演。
结果· 数值验证表明该方法能准确恢复弹性常数并大幅降低计算成本。
验证· 通过数值模拟验证反演精度和效率。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The determination of second- and third-order elastic constants in slender metallic rods is challenging due to specimen size constraints, motivating a more efficient inversion approach.
Method· A two-stage inversion framework is proposed, integrating a wave finite element forward model with a surrogate-assisted CMA-ES optimizer to solve the ill-conditioned inverse problem.
Result· Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate recovery of both second- and third-order elastic constants with significantly reduced computational cost.
Validation· The method is validated through numerical benchmarks, showing its effectiveness in recovering elastic constants.

单位: China Yangtze Power Co., Ltd. , ,
相关性: 该论文展示了将代理模型与全局优化结合用于结构动力学设计的方法，对用户研究中的FEA代理建模和优化具有方法迁移价值。
边界: This paper does not address biomedical implant mechanics, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface, and lacks uncertainty quantification.
动机· 提高大型水轮机顶盖模态识别与加固设计的效率和客观性。
方法· 建立参数化有限元模型，结合加权最小二乘傅里叶拟合识别节径，训练约束代理模型并全局优化加固参数。
结果· 前十阶固有频率提升24.51%-54.52%，代理模型R²=0.9999，优化后频率偏差小于0.15%。
验证· 通过有限元仿真验证优化结果，未涉及实验测试。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop an automated and physically consistent framework for modal identification and reinforcement design of large hydroturbine head covers, improving efficiency and objectivity.
Method· A parametric prestressed modal analysis is combined with a weighted least-squares Fourier fitting for nodal diameter identification, and a modal-order-constrained surrogate model is trained and coupled with global optimization to determine reinforcement parameters.
Result· The coordinated reinforcement scheme increased the first ten natural frequencies by 24.51%-54.52%, and the surrogate model achieved an R² of 0.9999, with optimized frequencies deviating less than 0.15% from targets after finite element validation.
Validation· Validation was performed through finite element simulations of the optimized design, without experimental or physical testing.

边界: This paper does not address bioprinting processes, bioink properties, or any printing workflow stage; it focuses on endovascular microrobot navigation.
动机· 单平面透视缺乏深度信息，阻碍微机器人自主导航的临床转化。
方法· 提出VISTA数字孪生框架，重建3D血管并离散化中心线，将2D位置映射到最近里程碑以生成磁驱动指令。

Motivation· The lack of depth information in single-plane fluoroscopy impedes the clinical translation of autonomous navigation for untethered microrobots.
Method· VISTA constructs a 3D digital twin of the vascular anatomy, discretizes the centerline into milestones, and maps the 2D robot position to the nearest projected milestone to generate magnetic actuation commands.
Result· In phantom and in vivo rat experiments, VISTA reduced navigation time by up to 62%, corrective commands by up to 98%, and radiation exposure by up to 57% compared to conventional human-in-the-loop control.
Validation· Validation was performed using anatomically distinct vascular phantoms under flow and in the inferior vena cava of a live rat.

Motivation· Classical PDE solvers are computationally expensive for repeated simulations across varying initial conditions, motivating the need for efficient learned surrogates.
Method· The paper proposes a trainable Neural Cellular Automata (NCA) surrogate that learns a local, homogeneous update rule applied repeatedly at each grid cell to model long-time PDE dynamics.
Result· The proposed NCA model achieves the lowest long-horizon relative errors on the majority of five canonical PDE benchmarks compared to PDE-Net, PINN, and FNO.
Validation· The model is validated on five standard PDE benchmarks with temporal extrapolation beyond the training domain, comparing against three baseline surrogate models.

相关性: 该论文关注世界模型训练中的因果动作效应重加权，与用户的工程仿真（如FEA/生物力学）方向无直接关联，但可能对基于模型的强化学习或仿真代理模型有间接启发。
边界: This paper does not address engineering simulation, FEA/FEM data, or design optimization; it focuses on video generation and world models for embodied intelligence, with no connection to biomechanics or implant design.
动机· 现有世界模型训练中均匀MSE损失导致背景主导梯度，动作影响区域优化不足。

结果· 在多种动作条件世界模型任务上，CAER相比均匀MSE训练收敛到更优解，提升物理一致性、可控性和视觉质量。

Motivation· Existing world model training with uniform MSE loss is dominated by background tokens, leaving action-affected dynamics under-optimized.
Method· CAER contrasts predictions with and without action conditioning to localize affected tokens online and reweights supervision while preserving total coefficient mass.
Result· CAER achieves better convergence and improves physical consistency, controllability, and visual quality across heterogeneous action-conditioned world model tasks.
Validation· Validated on multiple action-conditioned video generation benchmarks, without engineering simulation or physics-based validation.

Motivation· The reliability of crane booms degrades over time due to uncertain loads and material deterioration, necessitating efficient time-variant reliability analysis considering multiple failure modes.

动机· 现有SINDy飞行控制研究缺乏对纵向-横向耦合和扰动估计的明确处理，且NMPC对气动模型保真度敏感。
方法· 提出物理信息SINDy框架，结合超螺旋滑模扰动观测器，将已知物理项保留，未知气动项从数据中辨识并嵌入NMPC预测器和观测器。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Existing SINDy-based flight control studies lack explicit treatment of longitudinal-lateral coupling and disturbance estimation, and NMPC is highly sensitive to aerodynamic model fidelity.
Method· A physics-informed SINDy framework is developed, retaining known physical terms while identifying uncertain aerodynamic components from noisy flight data, and integrated with a supertwisting sliding-mode disturbance observer in the NMPC architecture.
Result· The proposed controller reduces trajectory RMSE by factors of 2-3 during disturbance-active intervals and achieves 20.6% average RMSE reduction over the full trajectory compared to a least-squares-based controller with linear ESO.
Validation· Validation is performed via high-fidelity flight simulations using a wind-tunnel-derived ground-truth aerodynamic model.

Motivation· Fixed-size encoders in JEPA world models are either over- or under-provisioned for varying task complexity, motivating adaptive capacity growth.
Method· The proposed Successive Capacity Growth (SCG) method starts from a minimal encoder and incrementally adds attention heads or transformer blocks based on a task-agnostic test-and-verify mechanism with function-preserving expansion.
Result· SCG improves prediction loss by up to 23% over fixed large baselines while achieving up to 56 times parameter efficiency, with zero false-positive expansions.

Motivation· Multi-step CSI prediction lacks calibrated uncertainty estimates, which can lead to unreliable downstream decisions.
Method· TRACE-CRC combines trajectory-adaptive calibration, error profiling, and learn-then-test risk control to construct Frobenius-norm uncertainty balls around predicted CSI matrices.
Result· TRACE-CRC achieves reliable trajectory-level coverage with smaller uncertainty balls than conservative baselines while avoiding undercoverage of compact stepwise methods.
Validation· The method is validated on wireless communication datasets through numerical experiments comparing coverage and ball sizes against several baselines.

Result· The Diamond topology at 25% relative density and 200 J impact energy exhibited the best trade-off, achieving approximately 60% imprint volume recovery after thermal activation.

Motivation· To address the autoregressive instability of neural operators in transient dynamics with strong discontinuities, which causes divergence or collapse in long-term predictions.
Method· A constitutive Markov physics-informed neural operator (MPNO) is proposed, modeling one-step evolution as a Markov row-stochastic propagation operator with physics-coupled edge weights, ensuring spectral radius <= 1 by construction.
Result· MPNO achieves stable autoregressive rollouts with bounded error on multiple PDEs, outperforming WNO and matching FNO accuracy with about a quarter of FNO's parameters.

Result· Experiments on Gray-Scott, complex Ginzburg-Landau, Burgers', and linear convection equations show that PI-SAP more consistently preserves residual fidelity under aggressive sparsity, but no pruning criterion is uniformly optimal across all equations and sparsity levels.
Validation· The method is validated through numerical benchmarks on multiple nonlinear PDEs, comparing residual fidelity, solution accuracy, and kernel conditioning.

When Do Supervised UQ Ensembles Improve LLM Hallucination Detection? A Robustness Study

Exclude FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Peripheral Ignore numerical_benchmark UQ
Mohit Singh Chauhan, Vipin Gyanchandani, Dylan Bouchard arXiv preprint 2026-08-25 link
相关性: 该论文研究大语言模型中的不确定性量化集成方法，与生物医学有限元代理建模或植入物设计无关。
边界: This paper does not address finite element analysis, surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical engineering application; it focuses on hallucination detection in LLMs.
动机· 研究监督式UQ集成在LLM幻觉检测中的鲁棒性。
方法· 在多个LLM和数据集上训练分类器集成异构UQ评分器，并评估样本效率、迁移和生成模式依赖性。
结果· 集成在多数设置中优于最佳单一评分器，且仅需少量标注样本。
验证· 在四个LLM、九个数据集和三种生成模式下进行系统鲁棒性分析。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The paper investigates the robustness of supervised ensembles of uncertainty quantification signals for hallucination detection in large language models.
Method· A classifier is trained over heterogeneous UQ-based scorer outputs on small labeled datasets and evaluated across multiple LLMs, datasets, and generation regimes.
Result· Supervised ensembles outperform the best individual scorer in most settings, with gains from as few as 100 labeled instances and robustness to distribution shift.
Validation· Systematic robustness analysis is conducted across four LLMs, nine datasets, and three generation regimes.
